stage1.impression: A night quay by a canal: a globe of coloured glowing rings on a black drum plinth, standing in a hard white spot that throws a pink, red and blue ring-shadow across grey pavers, with a lit facade and its reflections behind. The globe and its coloured shadow are a real idea, and the water reflections are convincing. But the frame reads as a clean CG stage set. A paper-white spotlight ellipse fills the lower half, the windows are flat identical lightboxes in a generic modern block, the pavers are a uniform dry tile, the lantern barely glows and there is no sign of life. A jury would see a striking object but a generic render, not Amsterdam. (The bar and speaker bar in the prompt don't apply: this frame is an outdoor light artwork, so I judged it as a night photograph of the work in place.)

blocking_9: The far side must read as Amsterdam: narrow brick canal houses with gables, varied warm interiors behind the windows, a tree or bridge rail, not a flat modern block of uniform lightbox windows
The spotlit paving must not be the brightest large area: spot pool median under about 110 with a soft, irregular edge, so the coloured shadow is the event and not the white ellipse
The coloured shadow must read as saturated stained-glass colour (all six hues traceable), not muted pink over grey
The quay surface must read as real worn Amsterdam klinker brick or stone with a damp sheen catching the rim colours, not clean uniform tiles
The street lamp must be a practical: a glowing lantern and a warm pool under it
Some sign of life and scale: a bicycle, a figure on the far quay or a passing boat light

defects.what: Far facade is a generic flat modern block. Lit windows are uniform paper-white or peach rectangles (lum_median 173 in one window) with no interior depth, curtains or variation. It reads as a CG lightbox, not Amsterdam canal houses
Hard spot pool is a large, near-neutral white ellipse (median 131, r136 g129 b129) with a clean theatrical edge at lower left. It reads as a stage spotlight and dominates the frame
Coloured shadow is muted (median 52, r76 g46 b38): mostly dull pink and red, with green, orange and violet barely traceable. The opaque mast and plinth shadow is a hard black wedge across it
Pavers are a uniform, clean, dry tile grid with a repeating texture and no wear, joints, puddles or kerb stone character
Street-lamp lantern barely glows (median 62) and casts no visible pool. The lamp at left is a dead prop
Paving under the street lamp is dim and flat (median 26). There is no warm pool
Plinth is a featureless black cylinder (median 13) with little sheen or edge definition and no rim-colour spill on its top
Water at right is near black (median 7.6) apart from the window streaks. There is no sky or far-quay ambient in the ripples
Sky is a flat grey-blue gradient with no cloud or city glow

changes.problem: The hard spot overpowers the frame: a big white ellipse washes out the coloured shadow and reads as a stage.

evidence.measured: lum_median 130.6, near neutral r136 g129 b129; shadow region median 52 against it

change.setting: the hard spot: power and colour (plus a softer cone edge)
change.to: 380 W, 3000 K, with a 15-20% blend on the cone edge

changes.expected: The spot pool drops to a warm grey of about 85-105, the edge falls off naturally, and the coloured shadow becomes the brightest-saturation event on the ground.

changes.problem: The far side does not read as Amsterdam: a flat modern block with uniform lightbox windows.

evidence.measured: Lit windows are identical flat panels at median 173 with no interior. Facade is unbroken dark slab

change.from: a single flat block, 0.45 of windows lit at glow 0.18, uniform
change.to: a row of narrow brick canal houses with varied gables and white window frames; 0.35 of windows lit, glow varied 0.06-0.14 per window, warm 2400-2900 K, with a ceiling lamp, curtain or bookshelf texture behind the glass

changes.expected: Windows read as rooms, not lightboxes. Their peak drops and varies, and the skyline says Amsterdam at a glance.

changes.problem: The quay paving is a clean uniform tile with no character or moisture, the main CG tell in the largest area of the frame.

evidence.measured: Repeating texture is visible at 2x crop. There is no specular response to the rims, the lamp or the windows

change.to: worn red-brown klinker brick in a herringbone or stretcher pattern, with a granite kerb at the water's edge, varied per-brick tone, dark joints and a damp sheen (roughness 0.35-0.5 with puddle patches near 0.15)

changes.expected: The ground catches faint coloured streaks from the rims and warm streaks from the lamp. It reads as a real quay and the spot pool becomes textured rather than flat.

changes.problem: The coloured shadow is muted and its hues are hard to separate.

evidence.measured: median 52, r76 g46 b38: a dull pink cast. Green and violet are barely traceable

change.setting: the hard spot's aim, and the far quay's fill
change.to: spot at [-2.0,-9.0,8.5] aimed [0.6,-1.8,0.0] so the shadow lands longer toward the kerb and water; far fill 0.08 W/m2 so the ground around the shadow is darker

changes.expected: The shadow stretches toward the water, and its overlaps separate into distinct red, blue, yellow, green, orange and violet lenses with a higher red-to-blue spread.

changes.problem: The street lamp is a dead prop: the lantern barely glows and there is no warm pool under it.

evidence.measured: Paving below the lamp has median 26. Lantern head median 62

change.to: 2 x point, 140 W, 2200 K, with the lantern glass set emissive (strength about 2) so the head reads as the source

changes.expected: A visible warm pool around the lamp base and a glowing lantern, which gives a second, warm practical against the cool spot.

changes.problem: The rims glow but spill almost nothing on the plinth and paving, so the globe doesn't feel self-lit.

evidence.measured: Plinth median 12.8, crush 2.3%. Globe region p95 178

changes.expected: Brighter, more saturated rims and a faint coloured spill on the plinth top and nearby paving, without the rims clipping.

changes.problem: The quay is empty and showroom-clean. Nothing gives scale or life.

evidence.measured: Only two bollards and a lamp. No bicycle, people, boat or bench

change.to: a bicycle leaning on the far-right bollard, two small figures on the far quay under a lit window, and a moored boat's dark hull along the far quay

changes.expected: The 2 m scale reads instantly and the scene feels like a real festival night.

changes.problem: The sky and water are flat and dead, without the orange city glow of an Amsterdam winter night.

evidence.measured: Sky median 45, neutral r48 g44 b44. Water at right median 7.6, crush 1.9%

change.to: a low overcast with a warm sodium city glow at the horizon, strength 0.10; haze 0.005/m so the spot's beam and the lamp halo are faintly visible

changes.expected: The sky warms slightly (r_median above b_median by 6 or more), and the water picks up a soft gradient instead of black.

out_of_scope.request: Make the disc faces slightly frosted or edge-polished thicker so the acrylic reads more premium and the rims glow more evenly
out_of_scope.why: The disc design (25 mm, clear faces, rim-lit) is fixed on the card

out_of_scope.request: Thin or hide the central mast and the opaque hub whose hard black shadow cuts through the coloured shadow
out_of_scope.why: That is part of the globe and plinth design, which is fixed
